Appendix & Technical Notes

Methodology, data sources, and risk legend for the IKIO P2P Audit

Risk Classification Legend

High Risk

Critical exceptions needing immediate action (e.g., 45-day MSME breaches, invoice without GE)

Medium Risk

Significant data gaps requiring process improvement (e.g., missing GSTIN/PAN, rate mismatches)

Monitor

Trends to track over time (e.g., early payment by SME category, payment aging distribution)

PO DataPurchase Orders
GRPO DataGoods Receipt PO

Audit Methodology

1
Data Extraction

All six ERP datasets (PO, GRPO, GE, Purchase Register, GL, Vendor Master) loaded as-uploaded.

2
Cleaning & Normalisation
  • •Dates parsed in dd-mm-yyyy.
  • •Vendor names normalised (lowercase, suffix-stripped) for duplicate detection.
  • •GSTIN validated against the 15-character standard.
  • •General Ledger nested header rows parsed into flat transaction list.
  • •Payment Delay Days rounded to whole integers (no decimal points).
3
Analysis Rules
  • •Variance threshold: 5% for both quantity and price.
  • •Quantity bucketing: 0–5% (within tolerance) and >5% (out of tolerance).
  • •Goods vs Services classification by Item Code prefix.
  • •FIFO payment matching for invoice ↔ payment linkage.
  • •MSME 45-day breach computed per MSMED Act §16.
4
Report Structure

Every analysis sheet has five layers in order:

i
Plain-English Business Logic
ii
Key Performance Indicators
iii
Charts with Clear Headings
iv
Summary Table
v
Excel Formulas + Data Relationships + Transaction List
5
Limitations
  • •Analysis is based on uploaded data; transactions after the snapshot are not reflected.
  • •MSME penalty uses an indicative 27% p.a. rate (3 × RBI Bank Rate of 9%).
  • •Service-line classification assumes Item Codes follow the documented prefix convention.

Glossary of Terms

TermDefinition
POPurchase Order – buyer's formal request to supply goods or services.
GRPOGoods Receipt against PO – the receiving document booked when goods enter stock.
Gate EntrySecurity record at the factory gate when material physically arrives.
AP InvoiceAccounts Payable Invoice – supplier's bill, posted in accounts.
GLGeneral Ledger – chronological record of every accounting transaction.
GSTIN15-character Goods & Services Tax Identification Number.
PAN10-character Permanent Account Number (Income-Tax).
MSMEMicro, Small and Medium Enterprise – per MSMED Act, 2006.
FIFOFirst-In-First-Out – matching the earliest invoice to the earliest payment.
3-Way MatchReconciliation of PO ↔ GRPO ↔ Invoice for Qty and Price.
Variance %( Difference ÷ Original Value ) × 100 — expressed as a percentage.
Aging BucketRange of days an invoice has been pending past due date.
NIL BalanceA vendor for whom Total Credit equals Total Debit – fully paid.
Days LateWhole-number difference between Payment Date and Due Date (no decimals).

Regulatory References

•
MSMED Act, 2006, Sections 15 & 16 — 45-day payment rule and compound interest for MSEs.
•
CGST Act, 2017 — Levy of tax, ITC eligibility, tax invoice format.
•
Income-Tax Act, 1961, Section 206AA — Higher TDS rate where PAN is not furnished.
•
Companies Act, 2013, Section 143 — Auditor responsibility on internal financial controls.
•
CARO 2020, Clause 3(ii)(b) — Auditor reporting on inventory and procurement controls.
•
RBI Master Direction on Bank Rate — Reference rate for MSME penal interest (3 × Bank Rate).
